records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our revenue increased by $61.6 million, or 32.3%, to $252.1 million for the three months ended July 4, 2025, from $190.5 million for the three months ended June 28, 2024, and our revenue increased by $177.2 million, or 33.5%, to $706.1 million for the nine months ended July 4, 2025, from $528.9 million for the nine months ended June 28, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •continued growth in the demand for high-performance analog, digital and optical semiconductors in our three primary markets;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, cash used in operating assets and liabilities was $34.3 million for the nine months ended July 4, 2025, primarily driven by an increase in accounts receivables of $22.8 million and an increase in inventories of $20.6 million, partially offset by an increase in accounts payable of $16.5 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was 55.3% and 53.2% for the three months ended July 4, 2025 and June 28, 2024, respectively, and 54.8% and 53.7% for the nine months ended July 4, 2025 and June 28, 2024, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, cash used in operating assets and liabilities was $36.1 million for the nine months ended June 28, 2024, primarily driven by an increase in accounts receivables of $17.9 million, an increase in inventories of $25.1 million, a decrease of $6.1 million in accrued and other liabilities, partially offset by an increase of $14.7 million in accounts payable.
